newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU announces 3,669 T veg oils food aid awards.
newsitem.headline: EU announces 3,669 T veg oils food aid awards.

text.p: The European Union announced the successful tenders for the supply of 3,669 tonnes of vegetable oils as food aid to a number of countries, a notice in Tuesday's EU Official Journal said.
The Journal, obtained on Wednesday, gives the successful tenders under Regulation 446/97 totalling 1,925 tonnes as: - Soyoil to India, 825 tonnes at 679.57 ecus to Cebag, Antwerp.
- Rape oil to Cape Verde, 1,100 tonnes at 779.84 ecus to AOH, Utrecht.
Results for the supply of 1,744 tonnes of rape oil under Regulation 488/97 were:
- World Food Programme (no destination), 1,257 tonnes at 668.96 ecus/t to Cebag, Antwerp.
- Egypt, 250 tonnes at 742.26 ecus/t and Yemen 237 tonnes at 773.50 ecus/t to Mutual Aid, Antwerp.
